response.sql: SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM account GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The share denominator is the total row count of the account table, and every account counts regardless of frequency or other attributes. Multiplying by 1.0 keeps the division real-valued, so the share is not truncated to an integer. Ties at 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows.
